hero.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle:
Find answers to common questions
about DoSee Wellness products and services.

wellcha-1.a: Dissolve it in hot water or warm milk and enjoy it as a morning coffee alternative, before work or study, or as an evening wind-down ritual. We recommend 1–2 teaspoons per 150–200 ml of hot water, or dissolved in 150–200 ml of warm milk.

wellcha-2.q: What is the difference between Matcha Latte and Hojicha Latte?
wellcha-2.a: Matcha Latte is made from powdered green tea and contains a moderate amount of caffeine, known for supporting focus and providing antioxidants. Hojicha Latte is made from roasted green tea, has lower caffeine content, a toasty aroma, and is well suited for relaxing moments.

wellcha-3.q: How much caffeine does WellCha contain?
wellcha-3.a: Matcha Latte contains approximately 20–30 mg of caffeine per serving (about one-third of a typical coffee). Hojicha Latte contains approximately 10–15 mg per serving. The natural balance with L-theanine supports calm, steady focus — different from the jolt of coffee.

wellcha-4.q: Can I drink WellCha during pregnancy or while breastfeeding?
wellcha-4.a: WellCha contains caffeine. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, please consult your doctor before consuming and enjoy only in moderation. As a general guideline, caffeine intake during pregnancy is recommended to stay below 200 mg per day. Hojicha Latte has lower caffeine content.

wellcha-5.q: How many servings per day do you recommend?
wellcha-5.a: We suggest 1–2 servings per day as a guideline. Matcha Latte is great for mornings or afternoon focus sessions, while Hojicha Latte is ideal for evening relaxation or before bedtime.

wellcha-6.q: How should I store WellCha, and what is the shelf life?
wellcha-6.a: Unopened, the product can be stored for one year from the manufacturing date. After opening, keep away from direct sunlight in a cool, dry place and aim to finish within 1–2 months. We recommend storing in an airtight container to protect against moisture.

wellcha-7.a: The product contains milk-derived ingredients (coconut milk powder). For information on other allergens, please check the ingredient list on the product page. If you have any allergies, please review all ingredients carefully before purchasing.

wellcha-8.a: Because WellCha contains caffeine, we do not recommend it for young children. For children aged 10 and older who are not sensitive to caffeine, starting with a small amount may be fine. Hojicha Latte has lower caffeine content and may be a gentler option.

general-1.q: Where can I buy DoSee Wellness products?
general-1.a: Products are available through our official online store at doseewellness.com. We currently sell online only.

general-2.a: Shipping costs vary depending on your delivery address and order total. Please check the product page or your shopping cart for details. We occasionally run free-shipping promotions on orders above a certain amount.

general-3.q: Can I return or exchange a product?
general-3.a: If your product arrives defective or differs from what you ordered, please contact us within 7 days of receipt. We will arrange an exchange or refund at our expense. Returns due to customer preference are accepted only for unopened, unused items (return shipping is at the customer's expense).

general-4.a: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB), Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

general-5.a: Orders are delivered within 3–5 business days from the date of purchase (some regions may take longer). You can track your delivery status using the tracking number provided.

general-6.a: We currently ship within Japan only. We are considering international expansion in the future and will announce updates when available.

general-7.a: At the moment we only offer one-time purchases, but we are exploring a subscription option. Sign up for our newsletter to be notified when the service launches.

general-8.q: What is the DoSee Wellness concept?
general-8.a: Our mission is to deliver a small, meaningful cup that helps you care for yourself amid a busy life — not out of obligation, but out of genuine self-kindness. We blend the tradition of Japanese tea culture with modern wellness needs, valuing both ease of habit and everyday comfort.

general-9.q: How can I get in touch?
general-9.a: You can reach us by email at info@doseegroup.com. We typically respond within 1–2 business days.
